section.meaning: Native layer means through the nearest longitude column to the outlet; terrain-following cell edges displayed in actual ASL, without3x display exaggeration.

display_method: Bilinear scalar interpolation in space and interval-centre scalar interpolation in time, then fixed colour mapping. No Gaussian filtering, RGB blending or adjacent-frame fades.
limitations: Hypothetical source, seed42 modified terrain and frozen GFS scenario; not observations or a current geographic forecast.
Regional field41x31x16 is output binning on3km weather, not41x31 independent wind cells or resolved building wakes.
Finite particle sampling creates native zeros. Fine near96cubed fields are not used as regional observations.
Elevated panel is a maximum layer mean, not column-integrated mass.
Cumulative deposition is the final snapshot only; no repeated addition of snapshots.
No background/oxidation or qualified external chemical inflow.1km refinement was paused after stability failures.
